title: Cherry and Lime Iced Tea
changes_from_base: Black tea mixed with cherry juice and a lime-zest syrup, garnished with cherries and lime instead of lemon and mint.
summary: A sweet-tart iced tea that tastes like a cherry lime soda without the fizz: black tea, cherry juice and a zesty lime syrup, with fresh cherries in the glass.

ingredients.item: limes: finely grated zest and juice
fresh cherries, pitted and halved, plus lime slices to garnish

steps.title: Lime syrup
steps.text: Warm the sugar and water until the sugar dissolves, then take the pan off the heat, add the lime zest and leave it for 15 minutes to infuse. Strain, then stir in the lime juice; adding the juice off the heat keeps it fresh-tasting.

steps.title: Tea
steps.text: Steep the tea bags in the boiling water for 5 minutes, lift them out and top up with the cold water.

steps.title: Mix
steps.text: When the tea is cool, stir in the cherry juice and 5-6 tablespoons of the lime syrup. Taste, adjust and chill for at least an hour.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Drop a few cherry halves and a lime slice into each glass, add ice and pour in the tea.

tips: Sour (tart) cherry juice makes a sharper drink, so you may need the extra syrup.
Grate only the green part of the lime peel; the white pith adds bitterness.
Pitting the cherries over a bowl catches the juice for the jug.
storage: Keeps 3 days in the fridge. The lime syrup keeps 1 week in a sealed jar. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
